name: @hypaware/graph-cache
description: Team graph replica and the team graph and evidence commands agents use to explore a team's history.

commands.name: graph replica status
commands.summary: Show the team graph replica state and the age of its data

commands.name: graph replica refresh
commands.summary: Ask the daemon to check the team graph replica now

commands.name: query evidence
commands.summary: Read original session text from a team server (session_evidence)

commands.name: query team-graph discover
commands.summary: Team graph files matching your terms, and the sessions that touched them

commands.name: query team-graph neighbors
commands.summary: One hop from team graph nodes: what touched them, or what they touched

commands.name: query team-graph search
commands.summary: Find text inside candidate sessions on the team server
